verses.arabicText: وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-ṭūr
verses.translation: By Mount Ṭûr

verses.arabicText: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wakitābim-masṭūrin
verses.translation: And by the Book written

verses.arabicText: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fī raqqim-manshūrin
verses.translation: on open pages ˹for all to read˺

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-bayti l-maʿmūr
verses.translation: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-saqfi l-marfūʿ
verses.translation: And by the canopy raised ˹high˺

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-baḥri l-masjūr
verses.translation: And by the seas set on fire

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Inna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿun
verses.translation: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—

verses.arabicText: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Mā lahu min dāfiʿin
verses.translation: none will avert it—

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Yawma tamūru s-samāu mawran
verses.translation: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently

verses.arabicText: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Watasīru l-jibālu sayran
verses.translation: and the mountains will be blown away entirely

verses.arabicText: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fawayluy-yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīn
verses.translation: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna hum fī khawḍiy-yalʿabūn
verses.translation: those who amuse themselves with falsehood

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.transliteration: Yawma yudaʿʿūna ilā nāri jahannama daʿʿan
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell

verses.arabicText: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hādhihi n-nāru allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūn
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny

verses.arabicText: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Afasiḥ'run hādhā am antum lā tub'ṣirūn
verses.translation: Is this magic, or do you not see

verses.arabicText: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iṣ'lawhā fa-iṣ'birū aw lā taṣbirū sawāon ʿalaykum innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.translation: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātiw-wanaʿīmin
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss

verses.arabicText: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīm
verses.translation: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire

verses.arabicText: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”

verses.arabicText: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Muttakiīna ʿalā sururim-maṣfūfatin wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin
verses.translation: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna āmanū wa-ittabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biīmānin alḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā alatnāhum min ʿamalihim min shayin kullu im'ri-in bimā kasaba rahīnun
verses.translation: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed

verses.arabicText: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-amdadnāhum bifākihatiw-walaḥmin mimmā yashtahūn
verses.translation: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire

verses.arabicText: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kasal-lā laghwun fīhā walā tathīmun
verses.translation: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghil'mānul-lahum ka-annahum lu'lu-om-maknūnun
verses.translation: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls

verses.arabicText: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍiy-yatasāalūn
verses.translation: They will turn to one another inquisitively

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā mush'fiqīn
verses.translation: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people

verses.arabicText: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.transliteration: Famanna l-lahu ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhāba s-samūm
verses.translation: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Innā kunnā min qablu nadʿūhu innahu huwa l-baru r-raḥīm
verses.translation: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”

verses.arabicText: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Fadhakkir famā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bikāhiniw-walā majnūnin
verses.translation: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqūlūna shāʿirun-natarabbaṣu bihi rayba l-manūn
verses.translation: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qul tarabbaṣū fa-innī maʿakum mina l-mutarabiṣīn
verses.translation: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”

verses.arabicText: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am tamuruhum aḥlāmuhum bihādhā am hum qawmun ṭāghūn
verses.translation: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqūlūna taqawwalahu bal lā yu'minūn
verses.translation: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith

verses.arabicText: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falyatū biḥadīthim-mith'lihi in kānū ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true

verses.arabicText: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am khuliqū min ghayri shayin am humu l-khāliqūn
verses.translation: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators

verses.arabicText: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am khalaqū s-samāwāti wal-arḍa bal lā yūqinūn
verses.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺

verses.arabicText: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am ʿindahum khazāinu rabbika am humu l-muṣayṭirūn
verses.translation: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum sullamuy-yastamiʿūna fīhi falyati mus'tamiʿuhum bisul'ṭānim-mubīnin
verses.translation: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am lahu l-banātu walakumu l-banūn
verses.translation: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons

verses.arabicText: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum mim-maghramin muth'qalūn
verses.translation: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt

verses.arabicText: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūn
verses.translation: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am yurīdūna kaydan fa-alladhīna kafarū humu l-makīdūn
verses.translation: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum ilāhun ghayru l-lahi sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūn
verses.translation: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺

verses.arabicText: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa-iy-yaraw kis'fam-mina s-samāi sāqiṭay-yaqūlū saḥābum-markūmun
verses.translation: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”

verses.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fadharhum ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī fīhi yuṣ'ʿaqūn
verses.translation: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma lā yugh'nī ʿanhum kayduhum shayaw-walā hum yunṣarūn
verses.translation: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know

verses.arabicText: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.transliteration: Wa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūm
verses.translation: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise

verses.arabicText: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.transliteration: Wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-id'bāra n-nujūm
verses.translation: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars
